findings.summary: A likely secret value is stored in .env, which is not ignored by .gitignore.
findings.fix: Remove the value from .env, rotate the credential, and add .env to .gitignore.

findings.summary: Referenced in scanned code but not declared in any env file, Compose environment, or workflow env map.
findings.fix: Add DEPLOY_REGION to .env.example and the deployment environment, or remove the reference.

findings.summary: Set in runtime configuration but absent from the example env file.
findings.fix: Add LEGACY_SMTP_HOST to .env.example so new contributors can discover it.

findings.summary: Declared in an example env file but never referenced in scanned code.

findings.summary: Declared with different values across real env files.
findings.fix: Keep one source of truth, or document the override intentionally.
